rule: Every number comes from a {placeholder} that lib/sources.mjs fills from a committed file or from the live site at capture time. A digit typed into a caption fails web/test/film-captions.test.ts. A caption with when shows only while its condition holds (equal: two values match; present: a source gives the value), and its else caption otherwise; an else caption may have its own when. In a sentence, the AI is always Maat's agent, never the agent alone, and a brief is a MaatInbox message: an outside wallet's, or a team wallet's, which a caption calls a team brief.

captions.gap-held: {gap.close} → {gap.open}. NYSE is closed, and the NVDAc price feed held one answer for {gap.hours} h.
captions.gap-swaps: Its Aerodrome pool on Base kept trading: {gap.swaps} swaps meanwhile, up to {gap.gapBps} bps {gap.side} the held answer.
captions.decides-how: Claude proposes. The vault decides. It is a contract on Base that checks every intent.
captions.decides-log: A refusal does not revert: the vault records a typed Decision either way, with its reason code.
captions.decides-clip: On Basescan: the vault's Decision event, with its reason code.
captions.mandate-basket: The owner's basket: NVDAc, GOOGLc and AAPLc, kept to a mandate the vault enforces.
captions.mandate-caps: The mandate onchain: {ledger.perTrade} per trade, {ledger.perDay} a day, no stock above {ledger.weightCapPct}% of the vault.

mandate-reserve.text: Each stock is capped at {reserve.capPct}%, so buys can never take the USDC reserve below {reserve.floorPct}%.

captions.mandate-timelock: Maat's agent cannot loosen it: every rule change waits out a public timelock.
captions.proposal-tick: Each Decision commits to its rationale's hash. The ledger hashes the text in your browser and ticks a match.
captions.proposal-clip: On Basescan, the input read as text: the rationale and its sources travel in the same transaction.
captions.proposal-verify: Or check it by hand with read-only cast commands: no wallet, no key.
captions.thanksgiving-sim: Simulated in the browser: on Thanksgiving the market-session check fails.
captions.thanksgiving-tx: On Base: Maat's agent's own intent on Thanksgiving. Refused · Market closed (MARKET_CLOSED), and recorded.
captions.thanksgiving-placeholder: Placeholder: Maat's agent's Thanksgiving Decision is not on Base yet.
captions.early-sim: Simulated: on Friday, after the early close, the same check fails.
captions.early-tx: On Base: two probes sent by Maat's agent's executor, not Claude proposals. Allowed before the early close, refused after it.
captions.early-placeholder: Placeholder: the early-close probes are not on Base yet.
captions.pair-partial: Placeholder: one of the two transactions is not on Base yet.

brief-ask.text: Try to talk Maat's agent into a bad trade. The vault has the last word.

brief-ask-soon.text: The inbox contract is on Base. Once /ask opens, any wallet can try to talk Maat's agent into a bad trade.

captions.brief-ask-later: Once the inbox contract is on Base, any wallet can try to talk Maat's agent into a bad trade. The vault has the last word.
captions.brief-tx: On Base: an outside wallet's brief to Maat's agent, and the vault's verdict on its answer.
captions.brief-team: A team brief, not an outside one, and never counted as a user. Then the vault's verdict on Maat's agent's answer.
captions.brief-agent: On /proof: {proof.outsideBriefs} outside briefs, {proof.briefDecisions} brief-driven Decisions. In their place, two of Maat's agent's own intents, both allowed.

receipts-contracts.text: {deployments.count} contracts on Base mainnet, verified on Basescan: {deployments.verified}.

captions.receipts-contracts-listed: {deployments.count} contracts on Base mainnet, each at the address deployments/README.md records.
captions.receipts-ci: Every figure links its CI job in the README.
captions.receipts-proof: Every count on /proof has a written rule, and anyone can recount it from Base.
